name: Progress
usage: Upload and import progress, storage usage, completion of a profile

props.name: percent
props.description: How far the task has come, in percent from 0 to 100; values outside are clamped.

props.name: variant
props.description: Form: `line`, a bar with the value after it; `circle`, a ring with the value in the middle.

props.name: size
props.description:
Size: for `line`, the thickness of the bar (4, 8 or 12 px; `sm` for list rows); for `circle`, the diameter
(48, 80 or 120 px).

props.name: tone
props.description:
Color of the fill, for how serious the level is: `accent` for normal progress, `warning` and `danger` for a
level that needs attention (such as storage that is almost full), `success` for a good level. The track is a
lighter step of the same color. Ignored when `status` is set.

props.name: status
props.description:
Result of the task: `success` uses the success color and shows a check mark, `error` uses the danger color and
shows a cross, instead of the number; screen readers hear "60%, failed". When `status` and `tone` are both
omitted, it becomes `success` at 100%.

props.name: showValue
props.description: Shows the value (or the result icon) after the bar or in the ring.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name, such as "Upload of report.pdf"; screen readers read it with the value.

props.name: aria-labelledby
props.description: ID of the element that names the progress bar, instead of `aria-label`.

props.name: ref
props.description: The root element (the element with the `progressbar` role).

examples.name: Basic
examples.title: Basic usage
examples.description: A line in the accent color with the percentage after it; the track is a lighter step of the same color.

examples.name: Circle
examples.title: Ring
examples.description: `variant="circle"` shows a ring with the percentage in the middle; `size` sets its diameter.

examples.name: Levels
examples.title: Levels
examples.description:
For a level against a limit, such as storage, `tone` shows how serious it is: the fill and its track both
change color, so the level reads across the whole bar.

examples.name: States
examples.title: Completed and failed
examples.description: At 100% it becomes `success` with a check mark; `status="error"` shows a failure with a cross.
